u18-rollback-rehearsal.title: Rehearse U18-S then U18 rollback on a disposable chain; prove clean removal and clean re-apply
u18-rollback-rehearsal.cmd: Local disposable database container only (name cf1pilot-q1, removed at the end). Build the chain with the pinned runner: KEEP=1 SUITES=none IMG=ns1-base:snap bash C:/Dev/studioapp/docs/ops/continuity-pilot/phase2/scripts/run_u18s2.sh cf1pilot-q1 both C:/Dev/cpilot-iso/work/q1/chain.out . Apply host SQL files only through the helper: bash C:/Dev/studioapp/docs/ops/continuity-pilot/phase2/scripts/apply_sql.sh cf1pilot-q1 <supabase_admin|postgres> C:/Dev/<worktree>/<path>.sql . Apply the U18-S rollback, then the U18 rollback from the release package, assert with catalog queries (single statements, no semicolons, no redirection) that triggers, functions and privileges are restored, then re-apply the forward migrations cleanly. Finish with docker rm -f -v cf1pilot-q1.
